sentimento.text1: 📈 THE GAP IN THE WINNER CONTRACT WIDENED FROM 10.20pp TO 14.00pp, and this time both sides moved: Flávio Bolsonaro rose from 54.70% to 56.50% (vol USD 11.02M accumulated) and Lula fell from 44.50% to 42.50% (vol USD 11.36M accumulated), confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT, against the price confirmed on Sep 17. Flávio Bolsonaro's 56.50% stands above the highest value in the recorded readings of his series, 56.40% earlier today, in a series that begins on Apr 14. Lula's 42.50% stands 25.00pp below the top of his series, 67.50% on Aug 16, and 8.00pp above the floor, 34.50% on Apr 25.
sentimento.text2: ⚖️ THE SAME MOVE SHOWS UP LARGER, AND UPSIDE DOWN, IN THE RUNNER-UP CONTRACT FOR THE [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Flávio Bolsonaro falls 7.00pp, from 76.50% to 69.50%, and Lula rises 6.70pp, from 22.65% to 29.35%. The two books measure the same thing from opposite sides, because whoever becomes more likely to win becomes less likely to finish second, and in this round the runner-up book moved almost four times more than the winner book. The panel records the coherence between the two prices and attributes no cause to either move.
sentimento.text3: 🔴 THE TWO NATIONAL POLLS RELEASED ON Sep 17 AFTER THAT DAY'S CAPTURE INVERT THE [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) BETWEEN THEMSELVES. Datafolha, in person, field Sep 15 to 16, 2,002 interviews and a margin of 2.0pp, gives Lula 46% to 44% and repeats the same pair for the third round running. Futura Inteligência contracted by 100% Cidades, by phone, field Sep 11 to 15, 2,000 interviews and a margin of 2.2pp, gives Flávio Bolsonaro 48.1% to 43.7%. That is 6.4 points of distance between the two firms on the same pair, with the sign reversed: at Datafolha the pair fits inside the margins and is a [technical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico), and at Futura it falls outside two margins. 📅 On Sep 18 the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) register listed Veritá, with 40,500 interviews, and its numbers were not published at the time of capture. On Sep 20 two Palver waves are scheduled and on Sep 21 Quaest, Nexus and American Analytics.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 56.50% in the winner contract, up 1.80pp against the price confirmed on Sep 17, above the highest value in the recorded readings of his series, 56.40% earlier today. In the runner-up contract for the first round he falls 7.00pp, to 69.50%, which is the other side of the same move. In the two national polls of Sep 17 he has 44% in the runoff at Datafolha, behind Lula, and 48.1% at Futura, ahead.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 42.50% in the winner contract, down 2.00pp against the price confirmed on Sep 17, 25.00pp below the top of his series, 67.50% on Aug 16. In the runner-up contract for the first round he rises 6.70pp, to 29.35%. In the first round he leads both national polls of Sep 17, 39% to 36% at Datafolha and 38.3% to 37.7% at Futura, and in both the distance fits inside two margins.
sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 IN THE THIRD-PLACE CONTRACT FOR THE FIRST ROUND RENAN SANTOS OPENS DISTANCE OVER AUGUSTO CURY: he rises 5.00pp, to 49.00%, while Cury falls 1.90pp, to 41.00%, and Ronaldo Caiado falls 2.00pp, to 10.50%, against the values confirmed on Sep 17. ⚠️ In the WINNER contract the same Renan Santos falls 0.20pp, to 0.95%, below the lowest value in the recorded readings of his series, 1.00% earlier today. The two prices do not contradict each other: one measures finishing third, the other measures winning. The polls of Sep 17 put Augusto Cury ahead in both, 6% to 3% at Datafolha and 6.5% to 3.4% at Futura, which is the reverse of the book's order.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT (21:59 UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, and certification is per book: in this round all five tracked contracts were confirmed, winner, runner-up, third place in the first round, impeachment at the Supreme Court and Senate. Presidential book at USD 151.46M accumulated.

inss.text1: 🔴 THERE IS NO NEW ACT IN THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) FRAUD INQUIRY ON Sep 18. What stands is still the act of Sep 12, in which Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, and the procedural suspension he ordered also reaches the INSS cases, without changing their rapporteur.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 What links the INSS to the Master case here is procedural, not factual: both sets are suspended by the same decision, and the trial the full court opened on it on Sep 15 was suspended by Flávio Dino's request for more time to review the case, with no decision.
inss.impactoLula: There are four recent structured readings of government approval, from different firms and methods, and they do not compare as a series. Datafolha of Sep 17 measures 48% approval against 50% disapproval. Futura/100% Cidades of the same day measures 44.1% against 53.1%. AtlasIntel of Sep 17, by online questionnaire, measures 45.4% against 53.6%. Genial/Quaest of Sep 14 measured 43% against 50%. The four fall between 43% and 48% approval and between 50% and 53.6% disapproval, and the most favourable and the least favourable to the government came out on the same day.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on Aug 05, 46% against 48% on Aug 14, 45% against 48% on Sep 02, 43% against 50% on Sep 07 and 43% against 50% on Sep 14. The 5-point fall in approval over about a month stopped in the latest round. ⭐ On the management scale, the Sep 14 release brings 32% positive rating, 27% regular and 38% negative, with 3% not answering, and that is the breakdown the block now uses, with a single date.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the topic is about assessment and calendar, not about an act: there is no new act in the INSS fraud inquiry on Sep 18, the ruling on the suspension that reaches those cases remains stalled in the review request of Sep 15, and two new national polls bring government approval readings that differ by almost 4 points from each other.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 ON Sep 18 DANIEL VORCARO'S DEFENCE ASKED FOR HIS PRETRIAL DETENTION TO BE REVOKED, and cited in the filing the unresolved state of the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case at the Supreme Court as part of the argument. The defence stated it will appeal to the full bench if Edson Fachin keeps the detention (G1, Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo). The ruling on whether to investigate Alexandre de Moraes has been suspended since Sep 15 by Flávio Dino's review request, and the ruling on André Mendonça's conduct has been off the docket since Sep 17, with no new date.
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 THE CHRONOLOGY THE RECORD SUPPORTS: on Sep 12 Fachin took over as rapporteur and suspended the cases; on Sep 14 the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) delivered to the justices' offices the full data extracted from Vorcaro's phone, André Mendonça lifted the seal on the data about Banco Master's payment network and Moraes filed with Fachin a 121-point petition asking for the immediate termination of the investigation; on Sep 15 the full bench opened the ruling on Moraes and Dino requested a review; on Sep 17 Fachin, as president of the Supreme Court, pulled the ruling on Mendonça from the Sep 23 docket; on Sep 18 Vorcaro's defence asked for the detention to be revoked. ⚠️ Vorcaro's testimony to the Federal Police has been rescheduled to Sep 24, and the Federal Police summoned Daniel and Henrique Vorcaro to testify on Sep 30 in another inquiry. Vorcaro has been detained since November 17, 2025.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page is from the confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT. In that reading the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 4.60%, with USD 92 thousand accumulated, 0.45pp below the 5.05% confirmed on Sep 17. It is a thin book, and the panel does not attribute the move to any of the day's acts.
bancoMaster.conclusao: What changes from Sep 17 to Sep 18 is that the party started asking, not that the court decided: the two requests to investigate Supreme Court justices remain without a date, and it is Vorcaro's defence that moves, asking for the detention to be revoked and using the unresolved state of the case itself as an argument. The panel records the procedure and the price, without saying which of the two better describes the outcome.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act confirmed by two independent sources on Sep 18. He remains a target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos.
stf.moraes: On Sep 15 the full bench discussed whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, and the analysis was suspended by Flávio Dino's review request, with no decision on opening the investigation. It remains without a new date on Sep 18.
stf.gilmar: On Sep 18 he publicly acknowledged having had a meeting with Daniel Vorcaro and said he voted against Banco Master in a case he described as worth up to R$ 145 billion, saying the vote went against the banker (CartaCapital, Valor Econômico and Gazeta do Povo). On Sep 14 his office had received from the Federal Police the full data extracted from Vorcaro's phone.
stf.dino: On Sep 15 he requested a review in the ruling on the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes, which suspends the analysis for up to 90 days, and he had not returned the case by Sep 18. On Sep 17 he asked the Federal Police and the Securities and Exchange Commission to look into relations between Banco Master and a cemetery concession company, in a filing that cites André Mendonça.
stf.mendonca: On Sep 17, at the Superior Electoral Court, he rejected a federal deputy's filing against the Bolsa Família increase for lack of standing, and wrote in the decision that this is no pronouncement on the legality or constitutionality of the measure. That same night he was drawn as rapporteur of a second filing, by Renan Santos, on the same increase. At the Supreme Court, the ruling on the request to investigate his conduct as rapporteur of the Banco Master case has been off the docket since Sep 17, with no date.
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and institution, not of outcome. The two requests to investigate Supreme Court justices tied to the Banco Master case remain without a date, and on Sep 18 the party that moved was Vorcaro's defence, asking for the pretrial detention to be revoked and citing the unresolved state of the case itself. At the Superior Electoral Court, André Mendonça is rapporteur of both filings against the Bolsa Família increase and has already rejected the first for the plaintiff's lack of standing, without reaching the merits. In the confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT the contract paying on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 4.60%, 0.45pp below the previous day. The panel does not claim that the procedure moved the price.
stf.analise: 🏛️ THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 4.60% (vol USD 92 thousand accumulated), confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT, 0.45pp below the 5.05% of the price confirmed on Sep 17. ⚠️ It is a thin book, and today's move happens on a day when the Supreme Court decided nothing on the two investigation requests. It remains 21.50pp below the top of the series, 26.10% on Sep 11, and 2.50pp above the floor, 2.10% on Jun 8.
stf.fachin: On Sep 17, as president of the Supreme Court, he pulled from the Sep 23 docket the ruling on the request to investigate André Mendonça's conduct as rapporteur of the Banco Master case, without setting a new date. On Sep 18 he came to have on his desk the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's pretrial detention, which the defence filed and on which it promises to appeal to the full bench if denied.
